chapter.verse: Mi khempeuh aw, na khut uh beeng un! Lungdamna la nakpi-in sa-in Pasian phat un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa, a Sang Penpa, dipkuat-huai-a, leitung khempeuhah kumpi lian khat ahi hi.
Mi khempeuh eima nuai-ah, minamte i khe nuai-ah amah in hong zawhsak hi.
Ama itpa Jakob’ angtan’pih ahi, eima luah ding amah in hong teelsak hi.
Aw ging tawh Pasian paito a, pengkul aw tawh Topa paito hi.
Pasian tungah phatna la sa un, phatna la sa un! I Kumpipa tungah phatna la sa un, phatna la sa un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in leitung khempeuhte’ Kumpi ahi hi; lasakna tawh amah phat un!
Minamte tungah Pasian maang hi; a tokhom siangtho tungah Pasian tu hi.
Uliante in Abraham’ Pasian’ mite tawh kikhawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung’ lumte in Pasian aa ahi hi; amah sangpi-in kithangsak hi!
